The role would facilitate working sessions, maintain a decision and dependency log, and translate agreed workflow rules into testable acceptance criteria. It would coordinate review with operations, architecture, security and product stakeholders.
Any future plan remains subject to client discovery, data access, policy review and delivery capacity.

In a proposed pilot, the role would help define a narrow workflow, identify the systems and owners involved, and document assumptions before solution choices are made. It would coordinate review of access, retention, control and exception-handling requirements with designated client stakeholders.

The team would then prepare a reviewable set of process maps, decision records, interface questions and acceptance criteria. Scope and sequencing would be confirmed after discovery; this illustrative profile makes no claim about delivered work or business impact.
